'''Rolta,''' is an Indian [[multinational corporation|multinational]] [[technology]] [[company]], headquartered in [[Mumbai]], [[India]]. The company focuses on [[Information technology|IT]], [[business intelligence]] and [[Big data|Big Data Analytics]], [[Geographic data and information]] and [[Engineering]]. The company is listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/rolta-india-ltd/rolta/500366/|title=Stock Share Price rolta India ltd - Get Quote rolta - BSE|website=www.bseindia.com|accessdate=29 May 2017}}</ref> The company's [[Global depository receipt|Global depository receipt's]] are listed on the Main Board of the [[London Stock Exchange]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.londonstockexchange.com/exchange/prices-and-markets/stocks/summary/company-summary/US7757902074USUSDIOBU.html|title=ROLTA REGS share price (RTI) - London Stock Exchange|website=www.londonstockexchange.com|accessdate=29 May 2017}}</ref> The company's ‘[[Senior Note]]s’ are listed on the [[Singapore Stock Exchange]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/rolta-raises-1-090-cr-by-issuing-senior-notes-on-singapore-exchange-113051000272_1.html|title=Rolta raises 1,090 cr by issuing Senior Notes on Singapore Exchange|first=Shivani|last=Shinde|date=10 May 2013|publisher=|accessdate=29 May 2017|via=Business Standard}}</ref>

== History ==
The company was founded on 29 June 1989 by Kamal K. singh.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/rolta-india-ltd_rolta/reports|title=Rolta India: Reports, Company History, Directors Report, Chairman's Speech, Auditors Report of Rolta India - NDTVProfit.com|website=www.ndtv.com|access-date=2019-07-16}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/rolta-india-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-12663.cms|title=Rolta India History {{!}} Rolta India Information - The Economic Times|website=economictimes.indiatimes.com|access-date=2019-07-16}}</ref>
